title: A missing connection is a task, not a wall.

before.label: DEDICATED
before.title: Built in advance
items: I don't have a Linear integration.
The agent can only use what was built for it.
The user leaves to find a plugin or wait for the vendor.
Task blocked: the capability is someone else's job.

after.label: AGENT-BUILT
after.title: Created on demand
items: The agent figures out how Linear connects and sends a secure link.
The user logs in outside the chat; the agent never sees the key.
Connection verified, the stale issues get closed.
The proven workflow is saved as the linear-cleanup package.
